name: host-member-end-bounces-taken-ask
description: Teams Phase 2 (coordinator decision 6, 2026-09-26): billing's own thread budget, a lifetime cap for a host member, runs out in the turn that took support's ask. The append ends the member, so rule 53 does not apply: no turn_failed bounce and no member_idle. The ask the turn had taken is no pending row, so the end's refusal of pending mail cannot reach it; the same append bounces it member_ended with the end's result, whose causal is that member_ended. support closes the ask member_ended at once instead of waiting out its deadline for an answer from a member that has ended.
